newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market at $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market at $71 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting light to moderate inquiry.

Sales reported on 11,200 slaughter steers and 8,700 heifers; 75,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,500 formulated and 1,400 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs
lbs 71.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 70.50. Pen
Utility and Choice 2-4 1100 lbs including heiferettes 68.00.
